about_the_game:
Season [Roses] is Live! Return to 1461 and join the fateful duel between Lancaster and York!

[New Season Highlights]

  • New Weapon - Bastard Sword: Compatible with all armor types (Light/Medium/Heavy). With endless combo variations, it is the true jack-of-all-trades on the battlefield.

  • New 5-Star Unit - Royal Longbowmen: Extreme range + arcing shots that ignore terrain. No Seasonal Challenges required—unlock them directly with Honour!

  • Dual 4-Star Units: The first cavalry that can dismount for combat, the Yorkist Household Knights, and the self-healing anti-cav infantry, the Lancastrian Billmen.

  • New Map - Alnwick Castle: A fully upgraded Siege Battle map recreating the fight for this epic fortress.

[New Players - Massive Perks Provided]

  • Start Strong: Create a character and instantly receive 13 Core Units. Start your journey with zero cost.

  • Free Respecs: Attributes and Skill Points can be reset infinitely for free before Level 200. Experiment without fear!

  • Mentorship System: Rookies can borrow their Mentor's fully leveled and kitted-out Units for free. Graduate to receive a 5-Star Unit Selection Box.

  • Weekly Rotation: Try out a fully leveled, max-potential top-tier Unit for free every week.

[Veteran Returns - The Ultimate Burden Reduction]

  • Grind Slashed: Bandit Raid limits are gone! Now based on a "Reward Cap" system. Whether you carry or get carried, you can easily max out your weekly XP and Prestige.

  • Easier Unlocks: Mediterranean Units can now be unlocked directly with Honour. No need to grind old seasonal quests.

  • Return Gifts: The Hero's Journey has been reset. Tons of Treatises and Unit Medals are waiting for you.

  • Mentor Rewards: Become an Instructor, teach tactics, and earn Legendary Artillery (Divine Crow) and Epic Hero Schematics.

Conqueror’s Blade – A Real-Time Tactical Warfare Game on Multi-Civilization Battlefields

Step into the boots of a legendary Warlord and lead your troops into cinematic PvP siege warfare on ancient battlefields inspired by world civilizations.

Whether you’re a fan of grand-scale sieges, fierce ACT games, or in-depth real-time strategy, Conqueror’s Blade delivers an unmatched battlefield experience that challenges your tactical mind and rewards your leadership skills.

Multi-Civilization Battlefields: A Journey Through Time and War

Explore ancient battlegrounds inspired by iconic civilizations. From the cliffs of Thermopylae in Sparta to sandstorm-swept deserts along the Silk Road, and the blazing bamboo fortresses of Sengoku-era Japan – every map offers a distinct atmosphere and thrilling historical flavor. Dynamic environments and historically inspired terrain ensure that every fight feels immersive, strategic, and unforgettable

Highly Diverse Siege Battles: The Ultimate Test of Strategy and Tactics

Take part in truly massive siege battles with thousands of troops clashing on-screen. Use trebuchets to shatter walls, deploy siege towers to breach ramparts, and lead armored infantry through kill zones in fierce close-quarters combat. Each battle unfolds in three tactical phases–siege preparation, front-line assault, and point conquest–mirroring authentic military strategy and testing your command at every turn.

Troops Command: A Tactical Symphony of History’s Finest

Choose from over 100 historical troops from legendary cultures, including Spartan warriors, Viking raiders, medieval knights, Chinese dynastic warriors, samurai, winged hussars, royal guards, and deadly assassins.

Coordinate troop abilities like healing, charging, shield walls, buffs, and explosive attacks to dominate the field. With new troops and maps added regularly, you’ll constantly need to evolve your strategies to stay ahead.

Global Esports Arena: The Battlefield of the Brave

Step into the Conqueror’s Blade League (CBL) – the ultimate annual esports competition where warlords from around the world clash for glory. With over 1,000 participants and a prize pool worth tens of thousands of dollars, the CBL is where legends are forged!

Performance: Optimized for All Warlords

With advanced game engine optimization, Conqueror’s Blade delivers stable frame rates – even in massive thousand-troops battles – on low-spec machines. Immerse yourself in the chaos of war without compromising performance.

content_descriptors.notes: Gameplay consists of graphic and realistic-looking depictions of physical conflict, weapons and depictions of human injury and death.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel I5-6400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance: 1080p / 30fps, Low Quality Settings

  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Conqueror's Blade gives you a chance to be a true warlord. Commanding medieval troops in epic 15 vs. 15 siege battles, conquering cities with allies in the open world or fighting against players from all over the world – it's you who make the choice.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, French, German, Polish, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
